projects.name: AURIXA
projects.desc: Multi-tenant conversational care operations. Patients get calm self-service, staff get a shared workspace, platform teams get governed LLM assistance, all over one orchestration and safety layer.

projects.name: ReBo
projects.desc: A reports bot for any SQL database that learns from the people who use it. Ask in plain words; it writes one read-only query, runs it, and says how it read the question. Five independent walls stand between a question and a write, from a SELECT-only user to a syntax-tree guard. Repeat questions rerun with no model call; 44 of 48 matching numbers on a test company, at about two cents a question.

projects.name: GHDA-SaaS
projects.desc: Government health-data automation. Turns messy, multilingual survey reports into structured JSON, gap analysis and compliance insight.

projects.name: OCR-LLM-DIST
projects.desc: Document chat that never leaves the machine. OCR ingestion feeds local LLMs for streaming, grounded answers; Ollama and LM Studio swap freely.

projects.name: ai-automation
projects.desc: Support automation for a publisher. Classifies intent, runs hybrid semantic and keyword retrieval, and unifies one person's identity across WhatsApp, Instagram, email, web and SMS.

projects.name: JobSlave
projects.desc: Queue roles once; a local LLM answers screening questions while Playwright applies end to end. No cloud LLMs, no form grinding.

projects.name: OCR-LocalLLM
projects.desc: The single-file version: read a PDF, ask a local model questions grounded in it.

projects.name: Vigilix
projects.desc: A live, AI-annotated video wall for security teams. RTSP ingest, YOLO overlays, incident alerts, patrol view and multi-tenant licensing.

projects.name: DADM
projects.desc: A distributed defensive-AI mesh. On-device anomaly detection, encrypted federated updates and a defense-ontology graph. Offline-first, zero-trust, air-gap capable.

projects.name: FlowState
projects.desc: Video analytics for machines that may not call home. A FastAPI engine runs fifteen detectors across up to six cameras and fuses them into one 0 to 100 threat index, under an Electron and React console. A missing model greys out one detector with the reason named, never the console. Ships air-gapped, with its own Python runtime and bundled weights.

projects.name: KeepMeAwake
projects.desc: Keeps a laptop awake by asking the operating system nicely: a Windows power request or a macOS power assertion, never a fake keypress. Timers, schedules, battery rules, an overnight guard and an almanac of hours, in about 5 MB. A pure Rust core with every OS call behind a trait, signed auto-updates, and five decision records.

projects.name: AIDA
projects.desc: Health-facility programme intelligence. Postgres to Prisma to NestJS to Next.js, with an LLM layer that only narrates numbers the API already computed.

projects.name: RestroScraper
projects.desc: A lead-generation CRM. Scrapes business profiles, enriches and dedupes them, and tracks every lead through a pipeline.

projects.name: TracePulse
projects.desc: One decorator for execution tracing in sync and async Python: timings, exceptions and structured logs, at minimal overhead.

projects.name: shelf
projects.desc: An offline-first family reading server, forked and reshaped, with its own decision records and runbook.

projects.name: MirrorState
projects.desc: A behavioural enforcement system built on operational evidence instead of self-report.

projects.name: akshaybajpai.com
projects.sub: a site as a drawing set
projects.desc: A personal site issued as numbered architectural sheets, re-issuable in three CSS-only states, with an x-ray lens over any part. 100 on accessibility and SEO, 60 fps on a throttled CPU, no animation or 3D libraries.

projects.name: medhathapliyal.site
projects.desc: A notebook-style portfolio with page-turn transitions and full structured data.

projects.name: aiximius.com
projects.desc: A company site written by hand. No framework, no build step.

projects.name: ew-dashboard
projects.desc: A React analytics dashboard with a Testing Library setup.

projects.name: Merakiel.in
projects.desc: A doorplate for private client work. The root page publishes nothing; each engagement gets its own surface elsewhere.

projects.name: Alzheimer's thesis
projects.desc: Master's research: nine models benchmarked on OASIS clinical and neuroimaging biomarkers to classify dementia.

projects.name: Anime-face GAN
projects.desc: A generator and discriminator trained against each other until the faces convince.

projects.name: Chinese MNIST CNN
projects.desc: Fifteen handwritten numeral classes across fifteen thousand images.

projects.name: Tweet sentiment RNN
projects.desc: Recurrent models compared side by side on documentary reactions.

projects.name: Stock-price GRU
projects.desc: Stacked GRUs over windowed price history. Not financial advice.

projects.name: Cervical risk classifier
projects.desc: Imbalanced clinical data, judged on precision, recall, and ROC-AUC rather than accuracy.

projects.name: Hangman solver
projects.desc: Pattern filtering over a 250k-word dictionary with n-gram back-off for words out of distribution.
